title: Supervised machine learning gives an MRI atrophy-pattern score for Alzheimer's disease
summary: A supervised model trained on ADNI-1 MRI scans assigned a continuous AD score from regional atrophy patterns. It separated patients from controls with accuracy 89% (AUC 0.95) in ADNI-1 and 87% (AUC 0.93) in the independent OASIS-1 sample, and the score was associated with MMSE and weakly with verbal memory in a population sample (SHIP-Trend). The data are retrospective public cohorts.
ai_technology: Supervised machine learning model producing an atrophy-pattern AD score from structural MRI

evidence.tested: Validation within ADNI-1 and in the independent OASIS-1 sample, plus association analyses in SHIP-Trend.
evidence.unknown: The specific algorithm is not named in the abstract; clinical use is not tested; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Converted regional atrophy into a continuous score that detects AD.
